blockers.description: Model repository google/medgemma-1.5-4b-it is gated under Google Health AI Developer Foundations (HAI-DEF) Terms of Use. HTTP 401 Client Error returned: Access is restricted; missing HF_TOKEN authentication.
Directory model_weights/pretrained/ is empty (0 bytes). Hugging Face local cache contains only a 40-byte commit ref (refs/main) with no parameter weight snapshots.
Host machine possesses no NVIDIA discrete GPU (CUDA acceleration unavailable). PyTorch is configured for CPU-only execution.
Available host system RAM at execution time was 2.63 GB. Loading a 4.2-billion parameter model on CPU requires >= 8.5 GB (BF16) or >= 17 GB (FP32), which would trigger an out-of-memory kernel fault.

recommendation: Transition evaluation to Google Colab T4/L4 GPU environment with an authenticated HF_TOKEN accepting the HAI-DEF terms.
